blocks.zh: 績效管理與供應鏈夥伴管理
blocks.en: Performance Management and Supply Chain Partner Management

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Performance Management (績效管理) 的三大核心機制：績效衡量與報告、自我檢查、管理審查會議
blocks.en: Understand the three core mechanisms of Performance Management: performance measurement and reporting, self-inspection, and management review meetings

blocks.zh: 掌握 Supply Chain Partner Management (供應鏈夥伴管理) 中夥伴選擇、品質稽核、品質協議的要求
blocks.en: Master the requirements for Supply Chain Partner Management: partner selection, quality audits, and quality agreements

blocks.zh: 了解 Closed Loop Supply Chain (封閉迴路供應鏈) 的概念及其對持續改善的重要性
blocks.en: Understand the concept of the Closed Loop Supply Chain and why it matters for continual improvement

blocks.zh: 學習 Business Review Meetings (業務審查會議) 的議程架構與執行要點
blocks.en: Learn the agenda structure and execution points of Business Review Meetings

blocks.zh: 3.3.1 Performance Measurement and Reporting 3.3.1 績效量測與報告
blocks.en: 3.3.1 Performance Measurement and Reporting

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Performance Measurement and Reporting (績效衡量與報告)：這是品質系統中「量化管理」的核心。所有品質系統的組成部分都必須對照事先設定的目標進行衡量，而非只憑主觀感覺。這裡強調兩個關鍵要素：
blocks.en: Performance Measurement and Reporting: This is the core of "quantitative management" in a quality system. Every component of the quality system must be measured against pre-set goals, not just judged by subjective impression. Two key elements are emphasized here:

blocks.zh: Pre-defined Goals (預先定義的目標)：必須在執行前就設定好衡量標準，例如配送溫度偏差率、客訴回應時間等
blocks.en: Pre-defined Goals: Measurement criteria must be set before execution, for example the rate of temperature deviations during distribution or the response time for customer complaints

blocks.zh: Trends (趨勢)：不只看單一數據點，更要監控長期趨勢，才能在問題惡化之前發現徵兆
blocks.en: Trends: Look beyond a single data point and monitor long-term trends, so that warning signs are detected before a problem worsens

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 績效衡量就像開車時的儀表板。你不會等到車子拋錨了才去看油量，而是隨時監控油量、水溫、轉速等指標。當油量指針開始下降（趨勢），你就會提前找加油站，而不是等到完全沒油。GDP 的績效報告就是供應鏈的「儀表板」，讓管理者能即時掌握系統健康狀態。
blocks.en: Performance measurement is like the dashboard of a car. You do not wait until the car breaks down to check the fuel level; you keep watching fuel, engine temperature, and RPM. When the fuel gauge starts to drop (a trend), you look for a gas station early rather than waiting until the tank is empty. GDP performance reports are the "dashboard" of the supply chain, letting managers see the health of the system at any time.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「Regularly scheduled basis」是關鍵用語。法規稽核時，稽核員會檢查報告是否按照既定的排程產出。如果公司宣稱每月審查績效，但實際上六個月才做一次，這就是不符合項 (non-conformance)。建議在 SOP 中明確規定審查頻率，並保留每次審查的紀錄。
blocks.en: "Regularly scheduled basis" is the key phrase. During a regulatory inspection, the inspector will check whether reports are produced according to the established schedule. If a company claims to review performance monthly but in practice does so only once every six months, this is a non-conformance. It is advisable to define the review frequency explicitly in an SOP and keep a record of every review.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你是一家藥品配送中心的品質主管，你會設定哪些 KPI 來衡量配送品質？請列出至少五項。
blocks.en: If you were the quality head of a pharmaceutical distribution center, which KPIs would you set to measure distribution quality? List at least five.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR52 強調要監控「趨勢」而不只是看單次結果？請舉一個實際案例說明。
blocks.en: Why does TR52 emphasize monitoring "trends" and not just looking at individual results? Give a real-life example.

blocks.zh: 3.3.2 Self-Inspection (Internal Audit) 3.3.2 自我查核（內部稽核）
blocks.en: 3.3.2 Self-Inspection (Internal Audit)

blocks.zh: Self-Inspection / Internal Audit (自我檢查/內部稽核)：品質保證計畫必須包含自我檢查機制，而且範圍不僅限於自己公司，還要涵蓋內部供應鏈夥伴的品質系統。
blocks.en: Self-Inspection / Internal Audit: The quality assurance program must include a self-inspection mechanism, and its scope is not limited to the company itself but also covers the quality systems of internal supply chain partners.

blocks.zh: Closed Loop Supply Chain (封閉迴路供應鏈)：這是一個非常重要的概念。意思是製造商對其供應鏈中的每一個夥伴及其運作方式都有充分的了解與掌控。不是把產品交出去就不管了，而是形成一個「閉環」——從生產、配送到最終端都在監控之下。
blocks.en: Closed Loop Supply Chain: This is a very important concept. It means the manufacturer has a full understanding and control of every partner in its supply chain and how each one operates. The product is not simply handed over and forgotten; instead a "closed loop" is formed, with everything from production through distribution to the end point under monitoring.

blocks.zh: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action，矯正與預防措施)：自我檢查發現問題後，必須啟動 CAPA 流程，並持續追蹤 CAPA 的有效性，形成持續改善的循環。
blocks.en: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action): When self-inspection identifies a problem, a CAPA process must be initiated and the effectiveness of the CAPA must be followed up, forming a continual improvement cycle.

blocks.zh: 想像一家連鎖餐廳的品質管理。總部不能只管自己的中央廚房，還必須定期檢查每一家門市的食材儲存、烹飪流程和衛生狀況。如果某家門市的冰箱溫度偏高（發現問題），就要立即維修（矯正措施）並增加巡檢頻率（預防措施），然後追蹤維修後是否真的改善了（CAPA 有效性）。這就是「封閉迴路」——從發現問題到確認解決，每一步都有追蹤。
blocks.en: Think of quality management at a restaurant chain. Headquarters cannot look after only its own central kitchen; it must also regularly check food storage, cooking processes, and hygiene at every outlet. If the refrigerator temperature at one outlet is too high (problem identified), it must be repaired immediately (corrective action) and inspection frequency increased (preventive action), and then you follow up to confirm the repair really worked (CAPA effectiveness). That is a "closed loop": every step from finding the problem to confirming resolution is tracked.

blocks.zh: 「Closed loop supply chain」這個術語在 GDP 領域非常重要。近年來全球藥品供應鏈中頻繁出現偽藥、竊盜和溫度偏差等問題，都與供應鏈缺乏「封閉迴路」管控有關。製造商若對下游配送環節一無所知，就無法確保產品在到達病人手中時仍然安全有效。這也是序列化 (serialization) 和追蹤追溯 (track and trace) 法規背後的核心理念。
blocks.en: The term "closed loop supply chain" is very important in the GDP field. The counterfeit drugs, theft, and temperature excursions that have appeared frequently in the global pharmaceutical supply chain in recent years are all linked to a lack of "closed loop" control. If a manufacturer knows nothing about the downstream distribution steps, it cannot ensure that the product is still safe and effective when it reaches the patient. This is also the core idea behind serialization and track and trace regulations.

blocks.zh: 「開放迴路」(open loop) 與「封閉迴路」(closed loop) 供應鏈的主要差異是什麼？各有什麼風險？
blocks.en: What are the main differences between an "open loop" and a "closed loop" supply chain? What risks does each carry?

blocks.zh: 在自我檢查中發現某物流夥伴的溫度紀錄器故障率偏高，你會啟動什麼樣的 CAPA 流程？
blocks.en: During a self-inspection you find that a logistics partner has a high failure rate of temperature data loggers. What kind of CAPA process would you initiate?

blocks.zh: 3.3.3 Management Review Meetings 3.3.3 管理審查會議
blocks.en: 3.3.3 Management Review Meetings

blocks.zh: Management Review Meetings (管理審查會議)：這是品質管理系統中的最高層級審查機制。與 ISO 9001 的管理審查要求一致，目的是確保高階管理層定期檢視品質系統的運作狀況，並做出必要的決策。
blocks.en: Management Review Meetings: This is the highest-level review mechanism in a quality management system. Consistent with the management review requirements of ISO 9001, its purpose is to ensure that senior management regularly reviews how the quality system is performing and makes the necessary decisions.

blocks.zh: TR52 列出的七大議題涵蓋了品質系統的完整面向：
blocks.en: The seven topics listed in TR52 cover the full scope of the quality system:

blocks.zh: Audit Results (稽核結果)：來自內部和外部稽核的發現
blocks.en: Audit Results: Findings from internal and external audits

blocks.zh: Performance Metrics (績效指標)：實際表現與目標的差距分析
blocks.en: Performance Metrics: Gap analysis of actual performance against goals

blocks.zh: Non-conformances & CAPA (不符合事項與矯正預防措施)：問題追蹤與改善進度
blocks.en: Non-conformances & CAPA: Problem tracking and improvement progress

blocks.zh: Customer Feedback (客戶回饋)：退貨、客訴等第一線反應
blocks.en: Customer Feedback: Front-line reactions such as returns and complaints

blocks.zh: Product Status (產品狀態)：召回、缺貨等重大事件
blocks.en: Product Status: Significant events such as recalls and stock-outs

blocks.zh: Changes (變更)：可能影響品質系統的任何變更
blocks.en: Changes: Any changes that may affect the quality system

blocks.zh: Improvement (改善)：持續改善的機會與建議
blocks.en: Improvement: Opportunities and suggestions for continual improvement

blocks.zh: 管理審查會議就像公司的「董事會議」。董事會不會只聽財務數字，還要審查營運風險、客戶滿意度、合規狀態等全方位指標。同理，GDP 的管理審查也不能只看配送量，必須全面審視稽核發現、客訴趨勢、產品召回狀況等。這是管理層做出「系統性決策」的基礎。
blocks.en: A management review meeting is like a company's "board meeting". A board does not listen only to financial figures; it also reviews operational risk, customer satisfaction, compliance status, and other indicators across the board. Likewise, a GDP management review cannot look only at distribution volume; it must comprehensively examine audit findings, complaint trends, product recalls, and so on. This is the basis for management to make "systematic decisions".

blocks.zh: 注意這裡的「actual vs. goals」——績效指標必須是「實際值與目標值的對比」，而不只是呈現原始數字。例如，報告不應只寫「本月溫度偏差 12 次」，而應寫「本月溫度偏差 12 次，目標為 5 次以下，超標 140%」。這樣管理層才能快速判斷哪些領域需要優先關注。
blocks.en: Note the phrase "actual vs. goals": performance metrics must compare actual values against target values, not just present raw numbers. For example, a report should not simply say "12 temperature deviations this month"; it should say "12 temperature deviations this month against a target of 5 or fewer, 140% over target". This lets management quickly judge which areas need priority attention.

blocks.zh: 如果管理審查會議中發現「客戶退貨率連續三個月上升」，你會建議採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: If a management review meeting finds that "the customer return rate has risen for three consecutive months", what action would you recommend?

blocks.zh: TR52 為什麼要將「Changes that may impact the quality systems」列為管理審查議題？請舉例說明可能的變更類型。
blocks.en: Why does TR52 list "Changes that may impact the quality systems" as a management review topic? Give examples of possible types of change.

blocks.zh: 3.4 Supply Chain Partner Management 3.4 供應鏈夥伴管理
blocks.en: 3.4 Supply Chain Partner Management

blocks.zh: Supply Chain Partner Management (供應鏈夥伴管理)：TR52 明確指出供應鏈夥伴的品質「對產品安全至關重要」(critical to product safety)。這不只是一個管理議題，更直接關乎病人安全。
blocks.en: Supply Chain Partner Management: TR52 states explicitly that the quality of supply chain partners is "critical to product safety". This is not just a management issue; it bears directly on patient safety.

blocks.zh: 管理流程必須是 consistent and repeatable (一致且可重複) 的，這意味著必須有標準化的 SOP，不能因人而異或因時而異。TR52 將夥伴管理分為三個面向：選擇 (Selection)、稽核 (Audit)、品質協議 (Quality Agreements)。
blocks.en: The management process must be consistent and repeatable, which means standardized SOPs are required and the process must not vary from person to person or from time to time. TR52 divides partner management into three aspects: Selection, Audit, and Quality Agreements.

blocks.zh: 在藥品供應鏈中，即使製造商的 GMP 做得再好，如果配送夥伴未能妥善管控運輸條件，產品到達病人手中時可能已經變質。因此，供應鏈夥伴管理是 GDP 合規的核心支柱之一。近年來 FDA 和 EMA 都加強了對供應鏈透明度和夥伴管理的要求。
blocks.en: In the pharmaceutical supply chain, no matter how good the manufacturer's GMP is, if a distribution partner fails to control transport conditions properly, the product may already have deteriorated by the time it reaches the patient. Supply chain partner management is therefore one of the core pillars of GDP compliance. In recent years both the FDA and the EMA have strengthened their requirements for supply chain transparency and partner management.

blocks.zh: 3.4.1 Partner Selection 3.4.1 夥伴選擇
blocks.en: 3.4.1 Partner Selection

blocks.zh: Partner Selection (夥伴選擇)：選擇供應鏈夥伴不能只看價格，必須評估其是否有能力支持 GDP 合規。TR52 列出了五個關鍵評估領域：
blocks.en: Partner Selection: Selecting a supply chain partner cannot be based on price alone; you must evaluate whether it is able to support GDP compliance. TR52 lists five key areas of evaluation:

blocks.zh: Safety Records (安全紀錄)：運輸業者的事故紀錄、安全合規歷史
blocks.en: Safety Records: The carrier's accident record and safety compliance history

blocks.zh: Regulatory Certifications (法規認證)：如 VAWD (Verified-Accredited Wholesale Distributors，美國經驗證認可的批發經銷商)、ISO 認證等
blocks.en: Regulatory Certifications: For example VAWD (Verified-Accredited Wholesale Distributors, a US accreditation for wholesale distributors) and ISO certification

blocks.zh: Operational Policies and Procedures (營運政策與程序)：書面 SOP 是否完備
blocks.en: Operational Policies and Procedures: Whether written SOPs are complete

blocks.zh: Vehicle and Equipment (車輛與設備)：冷藏車、海運貨櫃、航空運輸設備的適切性
blocks.en: Vehicle and Equipment: The suitability of refrigerated trucks, ocean containers, and air transport equipment

blocks.zh: Security (安全保全)：防止竊盜、偽藥混入等安全措施
blocks.en: Security: Security measures to prevent theft and the entry of counterfeit drugs

blocks.zh: 選擇供應鏈夥伴就像選擇保母照顧你的孩子。你不會只問「收費多少？」，還會查看保母的證照、過去的照顧紀錄、居住環境是否安全、有沒有急救設備等。藥品是救命的產品，選擇配送夥伴時更應該謹慎，因為一旦出問題，影響的是病人的生命安全。
blocks.en: Selecting a supply chain partner is like choosing a babysitter for your child. You would not ask only "How much do you charge?"; you would also check the sitter's credentials, past care record, whether the living environment is safe, and whether first-aid equipment is available. Medicines are life-saving products, so choosing a distribution partner calls for even more care, because when something goes wrong it is the patient's life that is affected.

blocks.zh: TR52 特別提到參考 Good Storage and Shipping Practices Checklist（附錄 4.0 中的稽核檢查表）作為評估工具。這份檢查表是實務操作中非常重要的工具。此外，「include but are not limited to」這個法規常見用語表示列出的只是最低要求，企業應根據自身需求增加更多評估項目。
blocks.en: TR52 specifically refers to the Good Storage and Shipping Practices Checklist (the audit checklist in Appendix 4.0) as an evaluation tool. This checklist is a very important practical tool. In addition, the phrase "include but are not limited to", common in regulatory text, means that what is listed is only the minimum requirement; a company should add further evaluation items according to its own needs.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設你的公司需要選擇一家新的冷鏈物流夥伴來配送疫苗（2-8°C 儲運）。除了 TR52 列出的五個評估項目外，你還應該考慮：
blocks.en: Suppose your company needs to select a new cold chain logistics partner to distribute vaccines (stored and transported at 2-8°C). In addition to the five evaluation items listed in TR52, you should also consider:

blocks.zh: 該物流商是否具備即時溫度監控系統 (real-time temperature monitoring)?
blocks.en: Does the logistics provider have a real-time temperature monitoring system?

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差時的應急處理程序是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the emergency response procedure when a temperature excursion occurs?

blocks.zh: 過去 12 個月的溫度偏差事件有多少次？
blocks.en: How many temperature excursion events have there been in the past 12 months?

blocks.zh: 驗證過的冷鏈包裝方案是否符合你的產品需求？
blocks.en: Does the validated cold chain packaging solution meet your product's needs?

blocks.zh: VAWD 認證的主要目的是什麼？為什麼 TR52 特別提到這項認證？
blocks.en: What is the main purpose of VAWD accreditation? Why does TR52 specifically mention it?

blocks.zh: 在評估一家物流夥伴的「Vehicle and Equipment」時，你會檢查哪些具體項目？
blocks.en: When evaluating a logistics partner's "Vehicle and Equipment", which specific items would you check?

blocks.zh: 3.4.2 Quality Audit 3.4.2 品質稽核
blocks.en: 3.4.2 Quality Audit

blocks.zh: Quality Audit (品質稽核)：外部稽核是確保供應鏈夥伴持續符合要求的核心工具。TR52 強調幾個重要面向：
blocks.en: Quality Audit: External audits are the core tool for ensuring that supply chain partners continue to meet requirements. TR52 emphasizes several important aspects:

blocks.zh: Written Agreements (書面協議)：必須與服務提供者簽訂正式的書面協議，如 Master Service Agreements (主服務協議) 和 Quality Agreements (品質協議)
blocks.en: Written Agreements: A formal written agreement must be signed with the service provider, such as a Master Service Agreement and a Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: Risk-based Approach (基於風險的方法)：稽核方式可以是現場稽核 (on-site visit) 或問卷調查 (questionnaire)，取決於風險等級
blocks.en: Risk-based Approach: The audit may be an on-site visit or a questionnaire, depending on the risk level

blocks.zh: Marketing Authorization Holder (上市許可持有人)：品質稽核的責任歸屬於製造商或上市許可持有人的品質組織
blocks.en: Marketing Authorization Holder: Responsibility for the quality audit rests with the quality organization of the manufacturer or the marketing authorization holder

blocks.zh: 品質稽核就像房東定期檢查租客是否按照租約使用房屋。你不能只在簽約時看一次，之後就完全不管。租約中約定了「不能養寵物」「不能改變格局」等條件，房東需要定期確認租客是否遵守。同樣的，品質協議約定了溫度範圍、配送時限等要求，製造商必須透過定期稽核確認夥伴是否遵守。
blocks.en: A quality audit is like a landlord regularly checking that a tenant is using the property in line with the lease. You cannot look once at signing and then ignore it entirely. The lease sets conditions such as "no pets" and "no changes to the layout", and the landlord needs to confirm periodically that the tenant is complying. Likewise, a quality agreement sets requirements such as temperature range and delivery time limits, and the manufacturer must confirm through periodic audits that the partner is complying.

blocks.zh: TR52 的一個重要觀念：稽核檢查表中「不適用 (N/A)」的項目必須提供理由說明。這體現了品質管理中的「有意識的決策」原則——你可以判定某些項目不適用，但必須記錄為什麼不適用。例如，存放 EPS (發泡聚苯乙烯) 和瓦楞紙箱的倉庫不需要溫度分布圖，但這個判斷必須被記錄下來。
blocks.en: An important idea in TR52: any item marked "not applicable (N/A)" on an audit checklist must be accompanied by a rationale. This reflects the "conscious decision" principle in quality management: you may decide that certain items do not apply, but you must document why. For example, a warehouse that stores only EPS (expanded polystyrene) and corrugated cartons does not need a temperature mapping study, but that judgment must be documented.

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下你會選擇「現場稽核」而非「問卷調查」？請用風險評估的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would you choose an "on-site audit" rather than a "questionnaire"? Explain from a risk assessment perspective.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR52 要求「不適用項目」必須提供理由說明？如果不這樣做會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does TR52 require a rationale for "not applicable" items? What risks arise if this is not done?

blocks.zh: Master Service Agreement 和 Quality Agreement 的主要差異是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the main difference between a Master Service Agreement and a Quality Agreement?

blocks.zh: 3.4.3 Quality Agreements 3.4.3 品質協議
blocks.en: 3.4.3 Quality Agreements

blocks.zh: Quality Agreements (品質協議)：品質協議是 GDP 合規的法律基礎文件。TR52 強調以下要點：
blocks.en: Quality Agreements: The quality agreement is the legal foundation document for GDP compliance. TR52 emphasizes the following points:

blocks.zh: 責任歸屬：製造商和/或上市許可持有人負有最終責任，確保 GDP 指引中的各項要求被適當地分配給供應鏈中的各方
blocks.en: Allocation of responsibility: The manufacturer and/or marketing authorization holder bears ultimate responsibility for ensuring that the requirements of the GDP guidance are appropriately assigned to the parties in the supply chain

blocks.zh: 正式化：責任分配必須以正式的契約或品質協議形式書面化，不能只是口頭約定
blocks.en: Formalization: The allocation of responsibilities must be documented in a formal contract or quality agreement, not left as a verbal arrangement

blocks.zh: 定期更新：品質協議不是「簽了就放抽屜」的文件，必須定期檢視與更新，以反映最新的法規要求、營運變更和經驗教訓
blocks.en: Periodic update: A quality agreement is not a document that is signed and then put in a drawer; it must be reviewed and updated periodically to reflect the latest regulatory requirements, operational changes, and lessons learned

blocks.zh: 品質協議就像婚姻中的「婚前協議」加上「年度家庭會議」。婚前協議明確了雙方的權利義務，但隨著家庭狀況的變化（新成員加入、收入變動、搬家等），協議內容也需要定期更新。如果只簽了協議但從不更新，當實際情況已經大幅改變時，這份協議就失去了保護作用。
blocks.en: A quality agreement is like a "prenuptial agreement" combined with an "annual family meeting". The prenuptial agreement sets out each side's rights and obligations, but as family circumstances change (new members, income changes, moving house), its content also needs periodic updating. If the agreement is signed but never updated, it no longer protects anyone once the actual situation has changed substantially.

blocks.zh: 注意 TR52 使用了「covenants」(契約) 這個字——這是一個法律用語，強調品質協議的法律約束力。在實務中，品質協議通常包含以下內容：
blocks.en: Note that TR52 uses the word "covenants", a legal term that stresses the legally binding nature of the quality agreement. In practice, a quality agreement usually contains the following:

blocks.zh: 雙方的品質責任與角色分工
blocks.en: Quality responsibilities and division of roles of both parties

blocks.zh: 溫度控制與監測要求
blocks.en: Temperature control and monitoring requirements

blocks.zh: 偏差處理與通報程序
blocks.en: Deviation handling and notification procedures

blocks.zh: 變更管控程序
blocks.en: Change control procedures

blocks.zh: 稽核權 (right to audit)
blocks.en: Right to audit

blocks.zh: CAPA 的執行與追蹤機制
blocks.en: CAPA implementation and tracking mechanism

blocks.zh: 績效指標 (KPI) 與審查頻率
blocks.en: Performance indicators (KPIs) and review frequency

blocks.zh: 為什麼品質協議中必須包含「稽核權」(right to audit) 條款？如果沒有這個條款會怎樣？
blocks.en: Why must a quality agreement include a "right to audit" clause? What happens if it is missing?

blocks.zh: 品質協議「定期更新」的合理頻率是多久？有哪些事件會觸發非定期的更新？
blocks.en: What is a reasonable frequency for "periodic updates" of a quality agreement? Which events would trigger an unscheduled update?

blocks.zh: 3.5 Business Review Meetings 3.5 業務審查會議
blocks.en: 3.5 Business Review Meetings

blocks.zh: Management Review 像是「家庭內部會議」——全家人坐下來討論家庭運作情況；而 Business Review 更像是「家長與老師的親師座談會」——雙方坐下來討論孩子（產品）的表現、需要改善的地方、以及未來的需求（新學期的課程安排）。兩種會議都很重要，但參與者和討論重點不同。
blocks.en: A Management Review is like a "family meeting", where the whole family sits down to discuss how the household is running; a Business Review is more like a "parent-teacher conference", where both sides sit down to discuss how the child (the product) is performing, what needs to improve, and future needs (the curriculum for the new term). Both meetings are important, but the participants and the discussion focus differ.

blocks.zh: 「New product requirements (storage and transportation)」這個議題非常實務導向。例如，當公司即將推出一款需要 -20°C 冷凍儲運的新產品時，必須在 Business Review 中提前與物流夥伴溝通，評估其是否具備相應的能力，或是否需要額外投資設備。這是「前瞻性品質管理」的體現——問題要在產品上市前就解決，而不是出問題後才亡羊補牢。
blocks.en: The topic "New product requirements (storage and transportation)" is very practical. For example, when the company is about to launch a new product that must be stored and transported frozen at -20°C, this must be raised with the logistics partner in the Business Review in advance, to assess whether the partner has the corresponding capability or whether additional equipment investment is needed. This is "forward-looking quality management": problems are solved before the product is launched, not patched up after something goes wrong.

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家生技公司的品質主管，即將推出一款需要 -70°C 超低溫運輸的 mRNA 疫苗。在 Business Review Meeting 中，你應該與物流夥伴討論：
blocks.en: Suppose you are the quality head of a biotech company about to launch an mRNA vaccine that requires -70°C ultra-low temperature transport. In the Business Review Meeting, you should discuss the following with the logistics partner:

blocks.zh: 現有的超低溫運輸能力（乾冰供應、超低溫冷凍庫）
blocks.en: Existing ultra-low temperature transport capability (dry ice supply, ultra-low temperature freezers)

blocks.zh: 運輸途中的溫度監控方案
blocks.en: Temperature monitoring solution during transit

blocks.zh: 偏差處理的應急計畫
blocks.en: Contingency plan for deviation handling

blocks.zh: 需要的設備投資與時程規劃
blocks.en: Required equipment investment and timeline

blocks.zh: 相關人員的培訓需求
blocks.en: Training needs of the personnel involved

blocks.zh: 比較 3.3.3 Management Review Meetings 與 3.5 Business Review Meetings 的議題清單，找出兩者的異同。為什麼會有這些差異？
blocks.en: Compare the topic lists of 3.3.3 Management Review Meetings and 3.5 Business Review Meetings and identify the similarities and differences. Why do these differences exist?

blocks.zh: 如果某一次 Business Review 中發現物流夥伴的績效持續未達目標，你會採取什麼步驟？最終考慮更換夥伴的門檻是什麼？
blocks.en: If a Business Review finds that a logistics partner's performance continues to fall short of target, what steps would you take? What is the threshold for finally considering replacing the partner?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「Product availability」被列為 Business Review 的議題之一？它與品質管理有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why is "Product availability" listed as a Business Review topic? How is it related to quality management?

blocks.zh: Business Review Meetings (業務審查會議)：這是與外部供應鏈夥伴之間的定期審查會議，不同於 3.3.3 的 Management Review Meetings（內部管理審查會議）。兩者的議題看似相似，但有重要的差異：
blocks.en: Business Review Meetings: These are regular review meetings with external supply chain partners, distinct from the Management Review Meetings in 3.3.3 (internal management review meetings). The topics of the two look similar but there are important differences:

blocks.zh: 特別注意 Business Review 增加了兩個重要議題：
blocks.en: Note that the Business Review adds two important topics:

blocks.zh: Product Availability (產品可得性)：包含召回、退貨、缺貨等影響供應的事件
blocks.en: Product Availability: Events affecting supply, including recalls, returns, and stock-outs

blocks.zh: New Product Requirements (新產品需求)：新產品的儲存和運輸條件，可能需要夥伴升級設備或流程
blocks.en: New Product Requirements: Storage and transportation conditions for new products, which may require the partner to upgrade equipment or processes

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 績效管理三支柱：Performance Measurement and Reporting（績效衡量與報告）、Self-Inspection（自我檢查）、Management Review Meetings（管理審查會議）構成了品質系統持續改善的完整機制
blocks.en: Three pillars of performance management: Performance Measurement and Reporting, Self-Inspection, and Management Review Meetings together form a complete mechanism for continual improvement of the quality system

blocks.zh: 封閉迴路供應鏈：Closed Loop Supply Chain 是 GDP 的核心理念，製造商必須對整個供應鏈有充分的了解與掌控
blocks.en: Closed loop supply chain: The Closed Loop Supply Chain is a core idea of GDP; the manufacturer must have a full understanding and control of the entire supply chain

blocks.zh: 供應鏈夥伴管理三步驟：Partner Selection（選擇）、Quality Audit（稽核）、Quality Agreements（品質協議）形成完整的夥伴生命週期管理
blocks.en: Three steps of supply chain partner management: Partner Selection, Quality Audit, and Quality Agreements together form complete partner lifecycle management

blocks.zh: 品質協議的動態性：Quality Agreements 必須定期更新，反映最新的法規要求和營運變化
blocks.en: Quality agreements are dynamic: Quality Agreements must be updated periodically to reflect the latest regulatory requirements and operational changes

blocks.zh: 內外有別的審查機制：Management Review（內部）和 Business Review（外部夥伴）是兩種互補但不同的審查機制，各有其特定議題與關注重點
blocks.en: Different review mechanisms for internal and external: Management Review (internal) and Business Review (external partners) are two complementary but distinct review mechanisms, each with its own specific topics and focus

blocks.zh: 前瞻性規劃：Business Review 中的「New product requirements」議題體現了前瞻性品質管理的精神，確保供應鏈在新產品上市前做好準備
blocks.en: Forward-looking planning: The "New product requirements" topic in the Business Review reflects the spirit of forward-looking quality management, ensuring the supply chain is ready before a new product is launched
